findings.observation: The complete crown, side edges, lower point, and visible three-quarter depth remain fully inside the declared 8% safe margin.
Exactly one complete shield is shown, with no duplicate, detached component, character, or extra equipment.
The broad convex face, reinforced perimeter, crowned top, and tapered lower point read immediately as a medium heater shield.
A continuous thick rim, regularly placed rivets, joined face panels, convex shaping, and restrained three-quarter depth communicate plausible coverage, assembly, and weight.
Dark silver-blue starmetal dominates the face, rim, panel lines, and rivets, with no secondary material asserting a separate visible rank.
Meteor-scored surface texture and embedded star-like crystalline inclusions establish starmetal physically beyond palette alone.
Supernatural emission is limited to several tiny star-point inclusions; the shield body and rim do not glow as a whole.
The render maintains premium realistic painterly metal wear, cold key light, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal background, and a subtle reflective floor plane.

The large central eight-point star emblem and extensive celestial tracery make ornament carry too much of the starmetal identity, violating no-ornament-as-material-identity; the remaining declared negative constraints are satisfied.
